Results.ReviewText: Nice grill new, regulator failed after 1 year of occasional use and replacement part is too expensive. Support doesn’t pay any attention to what problems you message them about, they repeatedly give advice you tell them you have tried, and tell you about other products to purchase but are of no help. I would not recommend Q1200 grill, check other websites to see common problems.
Results.Title: Cute grill, Short Life, doesn’t deserve Weber nam

The best grease catching and cleanup design I have used, 
& fits throw away catch pans if you like the convenience.
Results.Title: Versatile Grill for Home & Camping.

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill for 1 or 2 people….very sturdy…grates are very well made/heavy
Results.Title: Good little grill

Results.ReviewText: Have used it a few times so far but it has done a great job with everything cooked on it so far
Results.Title: It’s small and convenient and cooks great!

Results.ReviewText: It’s my second Weber grill, this model. It’s the right size, cooks great, easy cleanup.
Results.Title: It does everything I want it to

Results.ReviewText: GREAT SMALL TABLETOP GRILL WITH PLENTY GRILL SPACE.  MY 3RD ONE OVER THE YEARS. LOVE IT!  EASY TO ASSEMBLE.
Results.Title: GREAT TABLETOP GRILL!

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill for 2 people or brats for a group of 8.  Had to replace regular after a couple months but was warranty covered.
Results.Title: Fun little grill.  Had to replace regulator.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second q series grill. I have had the original for over 15yrs and just felt the need to get this new one. Quality is still amazing and have always recommended to buy a Weber grill to anyone who has asked about grills.
Results.Title: The best little grill

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with this grill. Replaced my old stand up larger propane grill which was just more than we needed.  This grill is so easy to use, I just place it on a table outside and can grill food for one or more people. So quick and convenient.  I’m a new user so I haven’t had a lot of experiences with it yet.  Cleaning the grates was a chore the first time but I sometimes use grill mats to avoid the mess. Overall, this was a great purchase!
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText:
I love these little bbq's! This is my 3rd one. My first one was the white lid one but when I moved in 2020 getting a moving truck was difficult so had to make choices on what I moved, unforntionaly the BBQ didn't make the move. When I got settled I ordered the red one, but last winter it got attacked by mice. I had to throw it away. This time I ordered the green one since the green matched some of my outdoor furniture. So here is the "but" It was delivered March 7 but because of the snow I didn't put it together. Finally end of April I put it together. The problem was the flame was not adjustable and I couldn't get any heat out of it to cook. It was well past Amazon return window so I called Weber and the very first person I talked with was very nice person and he walked me through some steps and then told me he would send a free regulator and it would take up to two weeks to receive it. I received a fuel hose in stead of the regulator.I called Weber back and the person that I talked with again was very nice person and he said he would send me the regulator but again that would take up to 2 weeks. I received the regulator but you need a special tool to get the regulator off, finally got one at home depot. So between the fixed ratchet and the very short screw driver I still cannot get the regulator off!! I asked a handyman for help and he was going to charge me $100. 
I am a widowed 71yo women on a fixed income and cannot afford to buy a new bbq this year. I am in tears this will be the first time in over 35 years that I won't have a bbq.
Results.Title: Watch out for the regulator!!!

Results.ReviewText: Found same grill on side of the road 7 years ago. Lasted until about 5 months ago. Got the same grill. I LOVE IT!!!! 100 stars.
Results.Title: Old grill new.  reason for sticking w/ what works

Results.ReviewText: This is the second one I have purchased and we just love it! Perfect size as we have a somewhat smaller outside deck. But easy to put together, works exactly as expected and is a wonderful addition to our cooking!
Results.Title: Love this little Grill!

Results.ReviewText: My grill didn’t get hot. Weber customer support was good. They provided me with a new part to repair my defective grill. It did resolve the problem. This grill, however, still doesn’t meet my standards. It heats slowly and doesn’t maintain the heat well. My previous exact grill was heavier and had a much more efficient burner.  I’ve informed Weber of this.
Results.Title: Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a perfect small grill. I did not buy it for camping,  I bought it for my yard as I live alone and don’t need a large grill. It is the perfect one person grill. Beautiful quality, so easy to clean. Performs just like a large grill. I bought the adapter so I could hook it up to the 20lb propane tank.
Results.Title: Perfect small grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill!  It’s super cute and easy to use annd clean the grates.  Everything tastes amazing and the blue color is just a bonus! Wish I’d gotten it sooner. Can’t wait to take it camping too. Highly recommend
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Have had it for several weeks. Still getting used to it. Great size and big enough for my uses. Had trouble attaching a second small propane canister. Isn’t connecting so temperature won’t go up. Hope the attaching is the problem. Still working on it.
Results.Title: Great size and look.

Results.ReviewText: The same excellent results you’d get with a full-sized Weber gas grill, in a convenient, take-it-anywhere size. Whether you need it to be portable for camping or the beach, or just space-saving size for at home, this is the perfect little gas grill.
Results.Title: The Perfect Little Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love our grill! Its portable so we can go anywhere with it so that was a very big plus. Heats up quickly and cooks evenly.  I recommend getting the separate stand for it.
Results.Title: Perfect grill for the traveling family

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill for a couple of reasons. It heats up very quickly and the grill plates come out and can be cleaned very throuroughly. I can wipe down the inside too. It looks brand new after every time I use it. It is big enough to grill for a small group.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: Works great. We use it on the boat and at home. Perfect size.
Results.Title: Grilling on the bayou

Results.ReviewText: Great for camping but screwing the propane tank on can be difficult
Results.Title: Perfect for car camping

Results.ReviewText: Am enjoying my new Weber grill. it's bit slower than my old standard sized barbecue but more equalized heat. Also, sitting on its new table, it looks a lot classier than my old grill. It's quite adequate for a home grill for just the two of us.
Results.Title: Classy Looking Machine

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product! Easy to assemble and use. I highly recommend it.
Results.Title: Great Value

Results.ReviewText: Ease of use, recommend this product. Love to grill almost anything.
Results.Title: Recommended

Results.ReviewText: I enjoy my Weber Q1200 gas grill.  However, I had issue with the burner and reached out to Weber.  As of today I have no idea if the burner will be replaced (supposedly under warranty) or not. I submitted pictures and my receipt of purchase and one customer representative advised that I may purchase the burner via their website. Another customer representative asked for my address so I "assumed" a burner would be sent.  So far, nothing. This has been ongoing since April 9,2024.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: We absolutely love our Weber grill! It’s the perfect size for two people and is fast and efficient!
Results.Title: The Perfect Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love it. Small enough to travel in the storage compartment in our travel trailer. You're not gonna cook 2 dozen burgers on it, but it works perfect for the wife and I.
Results.Title: Weber top notch quality, as expected

Results.ReviewText: I'm just learning how to use this grill and was initially surprised to see that the temperature went up to 400 degrees even though I had forgotten to move the dial from ignite to a temperature range. Subsequent uses has produced good grilling.
Results.Title: Hot ignition

Results.ReviewText: It is just the size I was looking for. Like the shelfs. Just a light touch to start it.
Results.Title: Best Little Grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great portable barbecue! Well controlled temperature.
Results.Title: Great barbecue. Easy to transport. Easy to cause.

Results.ReviewText: Great portable grill. Easy to move around. Great look
Results.Title: Best portable grill

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill, sturdy construction, but slow cooking, not as hot overall as compared to my previous grill not a Weber model.  Not a 5 star but will adjust over time to its performance.
Results.Title: GOOD LOOKING - MOST SEEN IN THE CAMPGROUNDS

Results.ReviewText: nice even cooking, starts first click - little tough to clean
Results.Title: q1200 - back in the game

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill after doing numerous research. Love the set up! Very compact, helps that it has the side tables. We use this for grilling at the park, at home, and plan to use it for other various events. It's lightweight, small, but has a decent area to grill. It lights up quickly, holds heat, and grills to perfection! Can't wait to continue to take this thing everywhere with us, without the struggle of taking up too much space!
Results.Title: Best Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great product, pefcect for camping that we do regularly.
Results.Title: Great product
